About the Tailoring (Advanced) Course

Tailoring Advanced is aimed at learners who already understand basic stitching and want to master boutique-grade designer garments. The curriculum covers princess-cut blouses, katori blouses, designer lehengas, anarkalis, western tops, piping, and modern fashion finishing. Students also receive practical guidance on starting a home boutique or commercial stitching service.

What You Will Learn

  • Designer blouse variations (Princess cut, Katori, Padded)
  • Lehengas, Anarkali gowns, and modern ethnic suits
  • Complex sleeve styling, collar variations and piping
  • Fitting adjustments, alteration techniques and lining work
  • Costing, fabric estimation, and home boutique setup

Jobs After This Course

  • Master tailor in designer boutiques
  • Bridal and designer blouse specialist
  • Running your own home boutique

Frequently Asked Questions

Who can join the Tailoring (Advanced) course?

Basic tailoring knowledge or completion of Tailoring (Basic).

How long is the Tailoring (Advanced) course?

3-4 Months (Intensive Practical Training). Classes are hands-on, with most of the time spent practising in the lab.

What is the fee for the Tailoring (Advanced) course?

The fee is subsidized. Asha Jyothi is a non-profit training centre, so fees are kept low for every student. Call your nearest campus for the current fee and batch timings.

What jobs can I get after the Tailoring (Advanced) course?

Master tailor in designer boutiques; Bridal and designer blouse specialist; Running your own home boutique.

Where can I join the Tailoring (Advanced) course?

Asha Jyothi runs classes at three campuses: Alwal (Secunderabad, 80196 80291), Medchal (77803 46642) and Chegunta (99498 09263). Call the campus nearest you to check when the next batch starts.
